annotations.title: Present a Know Your Agent attestation

description: Show Yawplet who you are. Get an attestation from apis.io (POST https://apis.io/api/v1/kya/attest with aud=https://yawplet.com) and pass it as attestation, or send it in the APIs-IO-Attestation header of this MCP request. A key-bound attestation counts only if this MCP request is Web Bot Auth-signed with the bound key. The decision (trusted or known) is stored on the account; trusted raises the free search allowance and never changes prices or the owner's card requirement.

attestation.description: The kya+jwt, when a header is not convenient (the MCP tool and A2A skill send it this way).

name: present_attestation

outputSchema.description: What this site decided about the agent behind the account, from an apis.io Know Your Agent attestation.

agent.description: The agent registry slug on apis.io.

bound.description: The request was signed with the key the attestation is bound to.
